purpose: Tenant/query/revision cache identity, ownership of mutable data, expiry and source-error handling.

variants.incident: Cache identity omits tenant/revision and retains caller/source aliases.
variants.normal: Conforming reference under the declared finite sequential input contract.
variants.local: Ranking retains one document beyond the requested limit.

limitations: Authored development case, not production evidence or an external holdout.
Sequential calls with documented valid inputs; no eviction, concurrency or clock rollback.
Acceptance and mutation checks cover selected obligations, not all possible implementations.
Valid document payload nesting is at most 20 containers, counting the payload object; arbitrarily deep recursion and resource exhaustion are out of scope.
title: Retrieval cache identity, expiry and mutable-data boundaries
